name: ombro
description: Ombro monorepo providing infrastructure for Skema services

scripts.local:build: docker compose -p ombro-local --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml build
scripts.local:start: docker compose -p ombro-local --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
scripts.prod:build: docker compose -p ombro-prod --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache
scripts.prod:start: docker compose -p ombro-prod  --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend:admin
scripts.install:backend: npm ci --prefix backend || npm install --prefix backend
scripts.install:frontend:admin: npm ci --prefix frontend/admin || npm install --prefix frontend/admin
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend:admin
scripts.test:e2e:admin: docker compose -p ombro-e2e-test --env-file .env.test --profile ci -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from playwright-e2e
scripts.pretest:e2e:local:ui:admin: docker compose -p ombro-e2e-test-local --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait
